task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, go west. With that accomplished, make an attempt to head west. Then, make an attempt to head south. That done, travel west. After that, travel south. If you can manage that, take a trip east. After that, go to the south. After that, make an attempt to go east. With that accomplished, venture north. And then, attempt to go to the north. And then, take a trip east. Then, make an attempt to go south. After that, make an attempt to venture south. With that accomplished, venture east. And then, head south. And then, take the American key from the mantle in the silent study. And then, make an effort to go west. With that done, unlock the American box. And then, make absolutely sure that the American box within the launderette is opened. Then, take the keycard from the American box in the launderette. That's it!
